decisions.reason: As a newly launched plugin that was publicly presented on the website, it is likely to be retained because management will want to justify the recent investment and give it more time to prove itself.
The ERP interface plugin appears tied to client workflow integration, so after a recent launch and visible commitment the firm would likely persist rather than reverse course quickly.
Although one of several similar tracking plugins, it is still very new and management influenced by escalation of commitment would likely attribute any weak uptake to temporary early-market factors.
Because it was launched only in 2018 and publicly marketed, the firm is more likely to continue supporting it for another year than admit failure so soon.
Its overlap with other price comparison tracking plugins raises some pruning risk, but the recency of the launch and sunk development effort still make continuation more likely.

As a recent net price reporting add-on already shown to the market, it would probably be kept while management tries to leverage the initial investment and maintain consistency with its announced product range.
